# vivainsights (Python)

> Generated by tools/generate_discovery.py from vivainsights/discovery/workflows.yml. Do not edit manually.

Python package for analyzing and visualizing Microsoft Viva Insights data.
Prefer these functions over reimplementing Viva Insights aggregation,
segmentation, or visualization logic.

## Conventions

- Import as `import vivainsights as vi`.
- Person queries always use `PersonId` and `MetricDate`.
- Metric and organizational attribute names vary by query, product version,
  and language locale; pass them explicitly via arguments such as `metric`
  and `hrvar` instead of assuming English column names.
- Output form is selected with `return_type`; the R package uses `return`
  because `return` is a reserved keyword in Python.
- Grouped functions expose `mingroup`; keep this privacy threshold unless the
  user explicitly chooses another valid threshold.

## Workflows

- Import a Viva Insights query export: `import_query()`; input: Viva Insights CSV export; DataFrame with cleaned column names; privacy: Import applies no disclosure thresholds; validate and aggregate before sharing results. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.import_query.html
- Validate a loaded query before analysis: `check_query()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: message, text; privacy: Validation reports population counts; review before sharing externally. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.check_query.html
- Summarize organizational attributes and their data quality: `hrvar_count_all()`; input: Person-period query; Summary DataFrame of attributes, distinct values, and missing counts; privacy: Distinct-value counts can be small; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.hrvar_count.html
- Count distinct people in each group: `hrvar_count()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Small groups may be identifying; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.hrvar_count.html
- Compare the average of a metric across groups: `create_bar()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_bar.html
- Compare the distribution of a metric across groups: `create_boxplot()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table, data; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_boxplot.html
- Rank groups on a metric: `create_rank()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_rank.html
- Track a metric over time by group: `create_line()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_line.html
- Show week-by-week patterns for a metric: `create_trend()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_trend.html
- Scan several metrics across groups at once: `keymetrics_scan()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.keymetrics_scan.html
- Compare two metrics across groups: `create_bubble()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_bubble.html
- Profile groups across several metrics on one chart: `create_radar()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_radar.html
- Measure how many people fall above or below a threshold: `create_inc()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table, data; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_inc.html
- Measure how concentrated a metric is across the population: `create_lorenz()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: plot, table, gini; privacy: Curves describe the whole population; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_lorenz.html
- Plot a summary table that is already aggregated: `create_bar_asis()`; input: Pre-aggregated summary table; Bar chart figure; privacy: Apply disclosure thresholds when computing the summary table. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_bar_asis.html
- Visualize movement between two categorical states: `create_sankey()`; input: Two-column count table; Plotly Sankey figure; privacy: Small flows may be identifying; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_sankey.html
- Rank predictors of a binary outcome: `create_IV()`; input: Person-period query with a binary outcome column; return_type: plot, summary, IV, list, plot-WOE; privacy: Outcome flags can be sensitive; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_IV.html
- Calculate odds ratios for an outcome: `create_odds_ratios()`; input: Person-period query with a binary outcome column; return_type: table, plot; privacy: Outcome flags can be sensitive; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_odds_ratios.html
- Measure association between two metrics: `xicor()`; input: Two numeric series; Correlation coefficient; privacy: Correlations are population level; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.xicor.html
- Reshape a person query for survival analysis: `create_survival_prep()`; input: Person-period query; Person-level DataFrame with time and event columns; privacy: Person-level survival data is identifying; aggregate before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_survival_prep.html
- Estimate time until an event occurs: `create_survival()`; input: Person-level survival table; return_type: plot, table; privacy: Groups with fewer than mingroup distinct people are excluded. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.create_survival.html
- Segment people by how consistently they use a behaviour: `identify_usage_segments()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: data, plot, table; privacy: Segment tables count distinct people; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_usage_segments.html
- Identify habitual behaviour over a rolling window: `identify_habit()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: data, plot, summary; privacy: Person-level habit flags are identifying; aggregate before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_habit.html
- Identify people who left or joined the dataset: `identify_churn()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: message, text, data; privacy: Person identifiers are returned with return_type="data"; aggregate before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_churn.html
- Summarize employee tenure: `identify_tenure()`; input: Person-period query with a hire date column; return_type: message, text, plot, data, data_cleaned, data_dirty; privacy: Hire dates are identifying; aggregate before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_tenure.html
- Find weeks that deviate from the norm: `identify_outlier()`; input: Person-period query; DataFrame of weekly values with z-scores; privacy: Weekly aggregates only; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_outlier.html
- Flag weeks where a person was unusually inactive: `identify_inactiveweeks()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: text, data, cleaned_data, dirty_data; privacy: Person-week flags are identifying; aggregate before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_inactiveweeks.html
- Detect and remove holiday weeks: `identify_holidayweeks()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: text, plot, holidayweeks_data, cleaned_data, labelled_data; privacy: Weekly aggregates only; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_holidayweeks.html
- Identify populations with very low collaboration: `identify_nkw()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: data_summary, data_with_flag, text, data_clean; privacy: Person-level flags are identifying; aggregate before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_nkw.html
- Find the date range covered by a query: `extract_date_range()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: table, text; privacy: Date ranges are not identifying. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.extract_date_range.html
- Determine whether data is daily, weekly, or monthly: `identify_datefreq()`; input: Date column; One of daily, weekly, or monthly; privacy: Date frequency is not identifying. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.identify_daterange.html
- Find which columns are organizational attributes: `extract_hr()`; input: Person-period query; return_type: names, vars, suggestion; privacy: Attribute names only; values are not returned with return_type="names". docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.extract_hr.html
- Check that required columns exist before running an analysis: `check_inputs()`; input: Any DataFrame; Nothing when all required columns are present; privacy: No data values are returned. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.check_inputs.html
- Analyze collaboration between groups: `network_g2g()`; input: Group-to-group query; return_type: plot, table, data, network; privacy: Group-level flows can be small; apply disclosure policy before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.network_g2g.html
- Analyze a person-to-person collaboration network: `network_p2p()`; input: Person-to-person query; return_type: plot, plot-pdf, table, data, network, sankey; privacy: Network outputs can identify individuals; apply organizational privacy and disclosure policy. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.network_p2p.html
- Summarize centrality for a network: `network_summary()`; input: igraph network object; return_type: table, network, plot; privacy: Node-level centrality is identifying; aggregate before sharing. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.network_summary.html
- Simulate a person-to-person network for testing: `p2p_data_sim()`; input: Simulation parameters; Simulated person-to-person DataFrame; privacy: Simulated data contains no real people. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.p2p_data_sim.html
- Load bundled sample datasets: `load_pq_data()`; input: None; Sample DataFrame; privacy: Sample data is de-identified and safe to share. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.pq_data.html
- Add a constant column to analyse the whole population: `totals_col()`; input: Person-period query; DataFrame with an added constant column; privacy: Adds a constant column only. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.totals_col.html
- Convert column names into readable labels: `us_to_space()`; input: Column name; Formatted string; privacy: Formats text only. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.us_to_space.html
- Save or copy an analysis output: `export()`; input: DataFrame or figure; Writes a file or displays the object; privacy: Exported files inherit the disclosure properties of the analysis output. docs: https://microsoft.github.io/vivainsights-py/_api/vivainsights.export.html
